about_the_game:
Have you ever felt the immense satisfaction of a crunchy leaf under your foot?

Guide your feline friend by moving the mouse cursor - your playful fairy companion - as you frolic through a cozy, leaf-strewn forest in Cozy Crunch, a whimsical adventure where every satisfying crunch brings you closer to new rewards!

Whether you’re here for the leaf-crunching ASMR or to max out every upgrade, Cozy Crunch offers a comforting, playful escape into nature’s coziest corners.

Features

  • Satisfying progression. Start with a gentle stroll, but once you crunch that first leaf, you’ll crave more. MORE. FASTER. CRUNCHIER. Unlock powerful upgrades and transform into an unstoppable leaf-crunching beast.

  • Explore a magical forest. Journey through four hand-crafted regions, each with its own secrets, challenges, and rare leaves to discover.

  • Cozy original soundtrack. Relax into the warm atmosphere with music that adapts to your pace and mood.

  • Intuitive controls. Move your mouse, and your curious kitty will follow. It's that simple. It's that satisfying.

Wishlist Cozy Crunch and prepare to leaf your worries behind.

name: Cozy Crunch
short_description: Crunch leaves, chase upgrades, and unleash your inner forest beast in this cozy adventure where you guide a curious cat by moving your mouse. Simple controls, satisfying progression, and autumn vibes make this the most relaxing rampage you didn’t know you needed.
